title: Close the degree-512 AG gateway over F_8192
resolved_task: Verify a characteristic-2 and finite-field-descent-safe scroll obstruction at the m=13 gateway.
theorem_statement: If X/F_8192 is smooth, projective and geometrically integral with at least 262144 rational points, then every F_8192-rational divisor G of degree at most 512 satisfies l(G)<=80.
coding_consequence: A rational-point C_L(D,G) code concatenated with RM(1,12), with exact binary length 2^30 and distance certified by (262144-deg G)*2048 >=535822336, has binary dimension at most13*80=1040.
limitations: No new code or generator matrix is supplied.
The theorem does not rule out arbitrary outer codes or stronger distance certificates for divisors of degree greater than512.
proof_steps: Completeness excludes strange birational images in characteristic two by square roots and the product-space dimension bound.

Castelnuovo and Serre force a base-point-free birational g^80_512 and genus1404..1407.
Uniform-position Hilbert growth forces the hyperplane section to impose159 conditions on quadrics.
The arbitrary-field Castelnuovo lemma and linear normality force a degree79 rational normal scroll.
Adjunction forces ruling degree7; the cone case is impossible. The unique ruling descends overF_8192.
The resulting degree7 map to P1 bounds rational points by57351, contradicting262144.
